meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按分层流程检索 claude-mem 跨会话记忆库：先用 search 拿到带 ID 的索引，再用 timeline 看上下文，确认相关才取完整记录，必要时才翻原始工具输入输出；先筛后取以省 token。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话里的事，比如“这个我们修过了吗”“上次 X 怎么解决的”等，或需要用到以前会话的成果时触发。当前对话里的问题不归它管。

say.text: 我们之前是不是修过这个登录问题?
say.note: 它在历史会话里搜索并返回相关记录 ID

say.text: 上个月那次数据库迁移失败是怎么解决的?
say.note: 先给摘要,必要时再翻出当时的原始命令输出

say.text: 把 #11131 前后各三条记录拉出来看看
say.note: 用 timeline 展示该条记录前后的上下文

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory in layers: search for an index of IDs, timeline for context, get_observations for full records, and rarely get_tool_uses for raw tool I/O. It filters before fetching to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we do X last time?", or need work from earlier sessions. Questions about the current conversation are out of scope.

say_en.text: Did we already fix this login bug?
say_en.note: It searches past sessions and returns matching record IDs

say_en.text: How did we solve that failed database migration last month?
say_en.note: It returns summaries first, raw command output only if needed

say_en.text: Show me three records before and after #11131
say_en.note: Runs timeline to show context around that record
